name: Wendigo
ability: Bury a Town Card. If now there's at least 5 cards in the graveyard, also gain 2 fear. If 9 cards, also draw a card. If 13, also inflict 1 suspicion. If 17, double the previous effects.

name: Mothman
ability: Copy the effect of a town card whose cost is 3 or less.

name: Flatwoods Monster
modifier: At the start of the game, shuffle the drone deck and place it face-down near the shop.
ability: Bury every drone in your hand. For each erased, choose: draw two cards, or gain 3 fear, or inflict 2 suspicion.

name: Loveland Frogman
modifier: At the start of the game, take your Magic Die and place it in a convenient location.
ability: Roll the die. If it lands on 1-3, get that amount of Fear. 4-5, draw two cards. 6 - self-inflict 2 Suspicion.
